#!/bin/bash

# Deploy branches to their respective directories
deploy_branch() {
    local branch=$1
    local target_dir=$2

    # Create a temporary directory for checkout
    local temp_dir="/tmp/git-deploy-$$-$branch"
    mkdir -p "$temp_dir"

    # Check out the branch
    git --work-tree="$temp_dir" checkout -f "$branch" 2>/dev/null

    # If checkout succeeded, move to target
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        mkdir -p "$target_dir"
        rsync -av --delete "$temp_dir/" "$target_dir/" 2>/dev/null
    fi

    # Clean up
    rm -rf "$temp_dir"
}

# Read all refs from stdin
while read oldrev newrev refname; do
    branch=$(echo $refname | sed 's|refs/heads/||')

    if [ "$branch" = "main" ]; then
        deploy_branch "main" "/var/www/main"
    elif [ "$branch" = "dev" ]; then
        deploy_branch "dev" "/var/www/dev"
    fi
done
